==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I cast Ligo and Solvo on my UFO's tractor beam. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Ligo is my spell for creating links and Solvo is my spell for removing things. In this case, I created a magical link to the tractor beam that removes zombie curses on contact.) (My UFO resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.)
I then instructed my UFO to pull the elven zombies down from space back to the village.
The enchanted tractor beam cured the zombies and brought them home.
